images.caption: Haylen Ayers will play for her mother's alma mater, Vanderbilt, next season.

images.name: Nation Williams [1296x729]
images.caption: Nation Williams has committed to UCLA.

images.caption: Five-star forward Eve Long has committed to Notre Dame.

images.name: Lauren Hassell [1296x729]
images.caption: Lauren Hassell, a top-10 recruit in the SC Next class of 2027, is the first commit of the cycle for Vanderbilt.

images.name: Ryan Carter [1296x729]
images.caption: Ryan Carter's commitment gives North Carolina a third straight year of recruiting five-star backcourt players.

images.caption: Avery Arije is the third top 100 commitment for Notre Dame in the 2027 cycle.

images.caption: Zaniya Johnson is the third top-30 commit for South Carolina in the 2027 class.
